'''Werda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. Located within the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Werda occupied the ninth and outermost [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]]. A frigid world bereft of any [[Moon/Legends|moons]], Werda was classified as an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball. After the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] forces of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] journeyed from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to conquer the uninhabited planet that became [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TEA" /> the newly renamed [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] spread out to conquer the worlds of the surrounding system,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> including Werda.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet's name came from the archaic [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''werda'', meaning "darkness".<ref name="Mandoa">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Werda was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].
